messages:
anya: Heads up — saw a ~12% token-p95 regression on the canary for Llama-2-13B with paged attention enabled. Looks alignment/stride-related; kernel selector is falling back to slower paths when KV cache grows. Anyone else?

matt: Saw a blip on nightly too, suspected batching changes. Can you paste the perf snippet?

anya: Paste from perf-bot run:
```
perf-bot: run 2026-03-15
model: llama-2-13b
input: sim-dialogue-avglen=120
config: page_fusion=true, kv_layout=interleaved, dtype=f16, batch_size=8
p50: 18.2ms -> 20.5ms (+12.6%)
p95: 60.1ms -> 68.3ms (+13.7%)
kernel selection log: flash_fused -> fallback=flash_paged -> fallback=generic_attention
kv stride: 256 bytes
alignment: 64
```

jess: Hmm. interleaved + f16 + 64-alignment could cause uncoalesced loads on Ampere. Try planar/separate layout or bump alignment to 128. Also check batching heuristics — larger batch sizes flip kernel decisions.

kevin: I'll run a small matrix: layout {interleaved, planar}, dtype {f16, bf16}, alignment {64,128}, batch {4,8}. Which commit?

anya: commit 2f7a9c8 — running quick g5.4x smoke now, will paste results.

perf-bot: matrix 2f7a9c8 results:
```
interleaved,f16,64,b8 -> p95 68.3ms
planar,f16,64,b8 -> p95 62.5ms
interleaved,bf16,64,b8 -> p95 63.0ms
planar,bf16,64,b8 -> p95 59.8ms  <-- best
planar,bf16,128,b8 -> p95 58.9ms
```

matt: planar + bf16 looks clearly better. That suggests interleaved f16 paths trigger slow fallbacks due to stride/alignment causing kernel_selector to reject the fast kernel.

jess: There's a guard in kernel_selector.cpp like `if ((alignment % 64)==0 && dtype==f16) choose_fused_flash()`, but it doesn't consider stride > 128 which leads to uncoalesced accesses. I'll open a quick PR to add a stride check and bias toward planar when stride >= 256.

anya: Quick experiment: set batcher policy to `prefer_low_latency` (disable cross-request batching) + planar+bfloat16 — reduced p95 on canary by ~10% vs baseline. Recommend canary rollout with that config.

kevin: Note: bf16 path requires the newer cuops lib; quantized kernels still fall back differently. Also check GPU memory: planar looks like it uses more pages. What's the memory delta?

perf-bot: memory numbers:
```
planar,bf16,64,b8 -> GPU mem 9.2GB
interleaved,f16,64,b8 -> GPU mem 8.1GB
```

jess: Memory tradeoff seems acceptable for Dedicated clusters; for Hosted we should gate via routing policy per-customer. Will add config knobs.

anya: Created PR #423 to adjust kernel selector + add `kv_layout_hint=planar_for_alignment` opt-in flag. @kevin please review and add bench tests for boundary strides.

kevin: Acknowledged. I'll add regression tests in bench harness for alignment boundaries [56, 64, 72, 128, 256] and a small trace to assert kernel choice.

matt: Also please add a trace-span in runtime around kernel selection so we can tag traces when fallback occurs; will help correlate with latency spikes.

anya: Noted and pushed a small trace-change patch to the PR. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
